# <span id="aanchor147"></span> Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Compliance

FLOWCAL includes several features available to help operators meet the requirements of 43 CFR §§ 3170, 3173, 3174 and 3175—the replacement rules for BLM Orders 3, 4 and 5.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="BLM Tab">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />BLM Tab</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM Tab">

Each editor in FLOWCAL contains a BLM tab to capture data for meters, locations, tanks and caverns that are under BLM jurisdiction. To designate an item as a BLM property, click the BLM tab and select "Yes" from the BLM Property drop-down. Several regulatory identification fields on the BLM tab become active when the meter or location is designated as a BLM property. These include Facility Measurement Point (FMP) Number, Lease Number, and CA and PA Numbers.

You can also set the BLM Property designation and other BLM-specific fields using FcLoader.

The following meter reports include the BLM identification fields:

- [BLM GVS](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/BLM%20Reports.md#BLM)
- [Meter Sample and Analysis](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterSampleAnalysis)
- [Meter Edit Reasons](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterEditReasons)
- [Meter Characteristic](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterCharacteristics)
- [Meter Alarm Detail](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterAlarmDetail)
- [Meter Events](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterEvents)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="FMP Tier">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />FMP Tier</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="FMP Tier">

The daily average flow for a facility measurement point (FMP) determines the required frequency for inspection and permissible measurement uncertainty, and influences several other applicable practices. Each FMP is assigned to a volume tier based on the daily average flow calculated from the previous 12 months of data.

The FMP tier is calculated in FLOWCAL as part of the close process. You can also initiate the calculation from the [Toolbox](../Tools/Toolbox/Toolbox.md). An override is also available so that you can manually set the tier when a BLM variance has been granted.

FMP Tier calculations are displayed on the [BLM tab](../Meters/Meter%20Editor/BLM%20Tab.md) of the Meter Editor.

For additional details about the calculation process, see: [FMP Tier Calculation](FMP%20Tier%20Calculation.md).

The [BLM FMP Tier report](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/BLM%20Reports.md#BLM2) compiles a list of all designated BLM properties.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Meter Sample">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Sample and Analysis Report</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Meter Sample">

Several fields have been added to the gas quality sample and analysis details, including spot sample method, install and removal dates of a composite sample, and lab analyzer make, model and last calibration date. All fields may be imported to a gas quality source and are reported in the [Meter Sample and Analysis report](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/Meter-Location%20Reports.md#MeterSampleAnalysis).

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Gas Quality Validations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Gas Quality Validations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Gas Quality Validations">

Several gas quality validations have been added in accordance with the new rules. Missing components, an incorrect C6+ split definition, and past due C6+ characterizations are all validated and will generate meter exceptions if violated. FLOWCAL will report the C6+ characterization age before the past due date. Exceptions will be generated after 135 days (instead of six months) for a very high volume meter and after 255 days (instead of one year) for a high volume meter.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="HV Uncertainty">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Heating Value Uncertainty</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="HV Uncertainty">

BLM regulations require that measured heating value must have an annual average uncertainty of 1% or less for very high volume meters and 2% or less for high volume meters. FLOWCAL calculates heating value uncertainty when a source analysis is applied to a BLM gas meter, and generates exceptions if the uncertainty is not within range. The calculated heating value uncertainty is visible on the Meter Analysis detail within the Volume Editor.

FLOWCAL provides two heating value uncertainty reports:

- **[Heating Value Uncertainty](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/BLM%20Reports.md#Heating)** - Reports heating value, uncertainty and FMP tier for all meters in a list, highlighting FMPs that are out of tolerance
- **[Heating Value Uncertainty Exceptions](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/BLM%20Reports.md#Heating2)** - Reports only FMPs that are out of tolerance

#### See also:

[Heating Value Uncertainty Details](Heating%20Value%20Uncertainty%20Details.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="BLM Audit package">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />BLM Audit Package</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM Audit package">

<span id="AuditPackage"></span>FLOWCAL provides BLM Audit Package report group to assist in providing information required to satisfy BLM audit requirements. The BLM Audit Package report group includes the following reports:

- BLM Audit Package Cover Page
- BLM Gas Volume Statement - Daily
- Meter Characteristic
- Meter Events
- Meter Sample and Analysis

#### See also:

[BLM Reports](../Reports/Report%20Descriptions%20and%20Tips/BLM%20Reports.md)

</div>
